label: Communication clarity
include: clarity or consistency of the discharge explanation
exclude: medicine timing, warning signs, or access as the main issue
coding_rule: one primary theme; optional secondary theme; adjudicate unclear records

label: Medication help
include: understanding medicine names, changes, timing, or purpose
exclude: cost alone or general communication without medicine content
coding_rule: one primary theme; optional secondary theme; adjudicate unclear records

label: Warning signs
include: symptoms or changes that should lead to a call or urgent help
exclude: general follow-up access without a symptom cue
coding_rule: one primary theme; optional secondary theme; adjudicate unclear records

label: Access after hours
exclude: digital format or routine appointment scheduling alone
coding_rule: one primary theme; optional secondary theme; adjudicate unclear records

label: Cost barrier
include: cost, affordability, or a lower-cost option
exclude: insurance category without a stated cost concern
coding_rule: one primary theme; optional secondary theme; adjudicate unclear records

label: Digital channel
include: video, online, device, or phone-versus-digital format
exclude: general telephone access without a digital format question
coding_rule: one primary theme; optional secondary theme; adjudicate unclear records

label: Respect and involvement
include: being heard, included, or involved in the plan
coding_rule: one primary theme; optional secondary theme; adjudicate unclear records

label: Other or unclear
include: a comment without enough information for another theme
exclude: any comment with a clear primary theme
coding_rule: one primary theme; optional secondary theme; adjudicate unclear records
